issues.description: SealSaloon.orderMeal has an inconsistent return type: the UML and text specify `orderMeal(Meal): void`, but the solution implements `public boolean orderMeal(Meal meal)`. Students following the specification will implement a `void` method, which will not match the reference API (and any tests expecting the specified signature).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the API with the spec by changing the solution to `public void orderMeal(Meal meal)` and removing boolean returns, or (less preferred) update the UML/text/tests to require a boolean return type.

issues.description: SealSaloon.stock staticness is contradictory within the problem statement: the UML shows `stock` as an instance association/field, but the text explicitly requires the `stock` attribute (and related methods) to be static/shared. This can mislead students about whether stock is per saloon instance or global across all instances.
issues.suggestedFix: Make UML and text consistent: if stock is intended to be shared, mark `stock` as static in the UML (and keep `static final` in code); otherwise remove the 'stock must be static' requirement and change the solution accordingly.

issues.description: Stock exposes an extra public API not described in the UML/spec: both template and solution include `public void setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[] stockIngredients)`, but the UML lists only add/take/find/addToStockIngredients/emptyStock for Stock. This can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and which methods are part of the required interface.
issues.suggestedFix: Either remove `setStockIngredients` from template/solution (preferred to match UML and encapsulation), or document it explicitly in the UML/spec as a testing-only helper method.
